verses.text: لِرَبٍّ غَفُورٍ قَدْ مَحَا عَنِّىَ الذَّنْبَا
verses.transcription: lirabbin ghafuurin qad mahaa hanniyaz zanbaa

verses.text: وَعَنِّى نَفَى إِبْلِيسَ فِى بَحْرِ مَايُنْبَا
verses.transcription: wa hannii nafaa ibliisa fii bahri maayunbaa
wa lii jaada bil qur-aani was sunnatil latii
takuqqul hidaa wal haara wan naara was sabbaa

verses.text: وَلِى قَادَ أَغْرَاضِى بِتَسْخِيرِ مَنْ طَقَوْاْ
verses.transcription: wa lii qaada aghraadii bitaskhiiri man taqaw

verses.text: وَلِى جَادَ بِالْحُسْنَى وَعَنْ مَّنْصِبِى ذَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa lii jaada bil husnaa wa han mansibii zabbaa

verses.text: وَلِى صَانَ أَسْرَارِ عَنِ الْكَوْنِ كُلِّهِ
verses.transcription: wa lii saana asraari hanil kawni kullihi

verses.text: وَعَنِّى نَفَى فِى غُرْبَتِى الشِّصْبَ وَالشِّعْبَا
verses.transcription: wa hannii nafaa fii ghurbatish shisba wash shihbaa
wa kuffal azaa hannii bihifzin yahuutunii

verses.text: وَقَانِى بِهِ فِى غُرْبَتِى شَرَّ مَا دَبَّا
verses.transcription: waqaanii bihi fii ghurbatii sharra maa dabbaa
mataabii wa ridwaanii wa shukri wa mahmadi

verses.text: فَأَكْرِمْ بِهِ رَبًّا فُؤَادِى بِهِ رَبَّى
verses.transcription: fa-akrim bihi rabban fu-aadii bihi rabbaa
sa-urdiihi habdan raadiyan hanhu shaakiran

verses.text: بِكَوْنِى لَهُ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لِّمَنْ حَبَّا
verses.transcription: bikawnii lahu habdan khadiiman liman habbaa
unaajiihi bil qur-aani shukran lahu bihi

verses.text: عَلَى حِفْظِهِ دَاْبًا وَأَرْجُو بِهِ الْحُبَّا
verses.transcription: halaa hifzihi da-ban wa arjuu bihil hubbaa
kitaabun haziizun laa yuraahiihi haabidun
wa yatluuhu illaa wahtawal fat-ha wal qurbaa
kitaabun kariimun min kariimin mukarrimin
lihabdin kariimin nawwarash sharqa wal gharbaa
kitaabun majiidun min majiidin mumajjiidin

verses.text: لِعَبْدٍ مَّجِيدٍ قَدْ عَلَا الْعُجْمَ وَالْعُرْبَا
verses.transcription: lihabdin majiidin qad halal hujma wal hurbaa
kitaabun haziizun min haziizin muhazzizin

verses.text: لِعَبْدٍ عَزِيزٍ دُونَهُ مَنْ حَوَى قُرْبَا
verses.transcription: lihabdin haziizin duunahu man hawaa qurbaa
fatuubaa lihabdin yahbudul laaha rabbahu
bitartiili qur-aanin haziimin yaqii karbaa
kitaabun bihi massaktu mustaghniyan bihi
ghariiban wa ansaanil musiibaati wal ka-baa

verses.text: بِهِ زَالَ غَمِّى حِينَ أَمْسَكْتُهُ هُدَى
verses.transcription: bihi zaala ghammii hiina amsaktuhu hudaa

verses.text: سَأَهْدِى بِهِ نَفْسِى وَأَهْدِى بِهِ الصَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: sa-awdii bihi nafsii wa ahdii bihis sahbaa

verses.text: فَمَنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ دَهْرًا بِهِ ذَاتَمَسُّكٍ
verses.transcription: faman lam yakun dahran bihi zaa tamassukin

verses.text: فَقَدْ قَادَهُ إِبْلِيسُ مَنْ لَّمَ يَزَلْ خِبَّا
verses.transcription: faqad qaadahu ibliisu man lam yazal khibbaa

verses.text: بِرَبِّى أَعُوذُ الدَّهْرَ مِنْ مَّكْرِهِ وَمِنْ
verses.transcription: birabbii ahuuzud dahra min makrihi wa min

verses.text: جَمِيعِ الْأَعْدِى نِعْمَ رَبُّ الْوَرَى رَبَّا
verses.transcription: jamiihil ahdii nihma rabbul waraa rabbaa
ilaahik finii ibliisa wahbis-hu sarmadan

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِى دَوَامَ الذِّكْرِ وَالشُّكْرِ وَالْحُبَّا
verses.transcription: wa hab lii dawamaz zikri wash shukri wal hubbaa
ilaahih bisil abdaa-a hannii wa najjinii
minal kufri wal kufraani wal takfinii salbaa

verses.text: إِلَهِى قِنِى مَيْلًا إِلَى غَيْرِ مُرْتَضًى
verses.transcription: ilaahii qinii maylan ilaa ghayri murtadan
wa jannibniyal aafaati wal takfinii khalbaa

verses.text: أَيَارَبِّ إِنِّى تُبْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَامَضَى
verses.transcription: ayaa rabbi innii tubtu min kulli maamadaa

verses.text: فَعَنِّى امْحُ عَيْبِى كُلَّهُ وَاكْفِنِى تَغْبَا
verses.transcription: fahannimhu haybii kullahu wakfinii taghbaa

verses.text: أَيَارَبِّ لِى اغْفِرْ وَامْحُ عَنِّى تَجَرُّإِ
verses.transcription: ayaa rabbi lighfir wamhu hannii tajarru-i

verses.text: وَلِى اشْكُرْ مَتَابِى وَاكْفِنِى رِدَّةً دَاْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lishkur mataabii wakfinii riddatan da-baa
lahu tubtu bil qur-aani mustamsikan bihi

verses.text: مَعَ الْمُصْطَفَى الْمُخْتَارِ مَنْ لَّمْ يَزَلْ حِبَّا
verses.transcription: mahal mustafal mukhtaari man lam yazal hibbaa
imaamil lazii sayyartanii khaadiman lahu
binazmin wa nasrin wal tunawwir bihil qalbaa

verses.text: لَهُ خِدَمَتِى مَادُمْتُ حَيًّا فَكُنْ بِهِ
verses.transcription: lahu khidamatii maadumtu hayyan fakun bihi

verses.text: مُحِيذِى مِنِ افْسَادٍ وَرُضْ لِى بِهِ صَعْبَا
verses.transcription: muhiizii minif saadin wa rud lii bihi sahbaa

verses.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِئَالِهِ
verses.transcription: lahuktub salaatan mah salaamin bi-aalihi
wa as-haabihi waqbal bihi minniyal kasbaa

verses.text: وَلِى هَبْ بِّهِ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَرَاغِبِى
verses.transcription: wa lii hab bihi dunyaa wa ukhraa maraaghibii

verses.text: وَزَحْزِحْ دَوَامًا عَنْ جَنَابِى بِهِ نَكْبَا
verses.transcription: wa zahzih dawaaman han janaabii bihi nakbaa

verses.text: وَلِى افْتَحْ بِهِ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا يَقُودُنِى
verses.transcription: wa liftah bihi fat-han mubiinan yaquudunii
ilal birri wat taqwaa wa jannibniyal hujbaa
ilaykash tikaa-i rabbi jahlii wa ghurbatii
faqudnii li-ikhwaanii bihi wakfinii tabbaa
wa hallimniyal hilmal ladu niyya baarihan
mutiihan taqiyan muflihan yurshidush shahbaa
wa bashshir zaawil islaami turran bi awbatii

verses.text: إِلَى إِخْوَتِى وَلْتَقْضِ لِى قَبْلَهَا الْأَرْبَا
verses.transcription: ilaa ikhwatii wal taqdi lii qablahal arbaa

verses.text: وَسُقْ لِى بِجَاهِ الْمُصْطَفَى الدَّهْرَ حَاجَتِى
verses.transcription: wa suq lii bijaahil mustafad dahra haajatii

verses.text: بِلَا كُلْفَةٍ مِّنِّى وَهَبْ لِى بِهِ الْجَذْبَا
verses.transcription: bilaa kulfatin minnii wa hab lii bihil jazbaa
wa hajjil khuruujii min huyuubii jamiihihaa

verses.text: وَقُدْنِى إِلَى طُوبَى وَعَنْهَا اصْرِفِ الْجَدْبَا
verses.transcription: wa qudnii ilaa tuubaa wa hanhas rifil jadbaa
wa hanhas rifish shaytaana was suu-a sarmadan
wa wajjih liyal khayraati wal tuuminit turbaa

verses.text: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا وَفِى كُلِّ مَاحَوَتْ
verses.transcription: wa baarik lanaa fiihaa wa fii kulli maahawat
wa fiihaa aqimnii wahdinit tirba fat tirbaa

verses.text: إِلَهِى إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ الَّتِى بِهَا
verses.transcription: ilaahii ilaa daaris salaamil latii bihaa
unaajiika qudnii haajilan wakfinii harbaa
wa jannib zawil hudwaani wash sharri jaanibii

verses.text: دَوَامًا وَهَبْ لِى النَّصْرَ وَالْوُدَّ وَالْقُرْبَا
verses.transcription: dawaaman wa hab lin nasra wal wudda wal qurbaa
wa zidnii huluuman zaa hudan was tiqaamatan

verses.text: وَبِى رَبِّ يَارَبِّى ذَوِى الْبُعْدِ وَالْقُرْبَى
verses.transcription: wa bii rabbi yaa rabbii zawil buhdi wal qurbaa

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِى بِكَ اسْتِغْنًا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ خَادِيمًا
verses.transcription: wa hab lii bikas tighnan hanil khalqi khaadiiman

verses.text: لِمَنْ جُودُهُ قَدْ أَخْجَلَ الْوَبْلَ مُنْصَبَّا
verses.transcription: liman juuduhu qad akhjalal wabla munsabbaa
habiibii aniisii figh tiraabii wa turbatii

verses.text: شَفِيعِى غَدًا يَوْمًا يُلَاقِى الْعِدَى تَلْبَا
verses.transcription: shafiihii ghadan yawman yulaaqil hidaa talbaa
halayhi salaatul laahi summa salaamuhu
bi-aalin wa as-haabin hawaw hindahu khisbaa

verses.text: إِلَهِى امْحُ عَيْبِى كُلَّهُ وَاكْفِنِى الْأَذَى
verses.transcription: ilaahimhu haybii kullahu wakfinil azaa
bihi wakfinil ahdaa-a wan naara was sabbaa
wa qudnii li-ahlii saaliman ghaaniman bihi
wa da-ban qinii ibliisa wal haara waz zanbaa
lakash shukru war ridwaanu minnii wa shaahidi
raqiibun hatiidun fil jaziirati maayunbaa

bayts.text: لِرَبٍّ غَفُورٍ قَدْ مَحَا عَنِّىَ الذَّنْبَا ۞ وَعَنِّى نَفَى إِبْلِيسَ فِى بَحْرِ مَايُنْبَا

translations.it.karamati: (Lode) a un Signore Perdonatore, che ha cancellato da me il peccato e ha respinto da me Iblīs, nel mare di Mayumba,
translations.en.karamati: (Praise) to a Forgiving Lord, Who erased sin from me and repelled Iblīs from me, in the sea of Mayumba,
translations.fr.karamati: (Louange) à un Seigneur Pardonneur, qui a effacé de moi le péché et a repoussé de moi Iblīs, dans la mer de Mayumba,

bayts.text: وَلِى جَادَ بِالْقُرْءَانِ وَالسُّنَّةِ الَّتِى ۞ تَكُقُّ الْعِدَى وَالْعَارَ وَالنَّارَ وَالسَّبَّا

translations.it.karamati: e mi ha elargito il Corano e la Sunna, che trattengono i nemici, la vergogna, il Fuoco e l'insulto.
translations.en.karamati: and bestowed on me the Qurʾān and the Sunna, which hold back enemies, shame, the Fire and insult.
translations.fr.karamati: et m'a prodigué le Coran et la Sunna, qui retiennent les ennemis, la honte, le Feu et l'insulte.

bayts.text: وَلِى قَادَ أَغْرَاضِى بِتَسْخِيرِ مَنْ طَقَوْاْ ۞ وَلِى جَادَ بِالْحُسْنَى وَعَنْ مَّنْصِبِى ذَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha condotto i miei scopi assoggettando coloro che si erano ribellati; mi ha elargito il bene più bello e ha difeso la mia posizione.
translations.en.karamati: He led my aims to me by subjecting those who had rebelled; He bestowed on me the finest good and defended my station.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'a amené mes buts en assujettissant ceux qui s'étaient rebellés ; Il m'a prodigué le plus beau bien et a défendu ma position.

bayts.text: وَلِى صَانَ أَسْرَارِ عَنِ الْكَوْنِ كُلِّهِ ۞ وَعَنِّى نَفَى فِى غُرْبَتِى الشِّصْبَ وَالشِّعْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha custodito i miei segreti da tutto il creato, e ha respinto da me, nel mio esilio, la penuria e le strettoie.
translations.en.karamati: He guarded my secrets from all creation, and repelled from me, in my exile, want and narrow straits.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'a gardé mes secrets de toute la création, et a repoussé de moi, dans mon exil, la pénurie et les défilés.

bayts.text: وَكُفَّ الْأَذَى عَنِّى بِحِفْظٍ يَحُوطُنِى ۞ وَقَانِى بِهِ فِى غُرْبَتِى شَرَّ مَا دَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ha trattenuto da me il danno con una custodia che mi circonda, e mi ha preservato con essa, nel mio esilio, dal male di ciò che striscia.
translations.en.karamati: He held harm back from me with a guarding that surrounds me, and by it shielded me, in my exile, from the evil of what creeps.
translations.fr.karamati: Il a retenu de moi le mal par une garde qui m'entoure, et m'a préservé par elle, dans mon exil, du mal de ce qui rampe.

bayts.text: مَتَابِى وَرِضْوَانِى وَشُكْرِ وَمَحْمَدِ ۞ فَأَكْرِمْ بِهِ رَبًّا فُؤَادِى بِهِ رَبَّى

translations.it.karamati: (A Lui) il mio pentimento, il mio compiacimento, la mia gratitudine e la mia lode: quanto è generoso come Signore! Per mezzo di Lui il mio cuore è cresciuto.
translations.en.karamati: (To Him) my repentance, my contentment, my gratitude and my praise: how generous a Lord He is! Through Him my heart has grown.
translations.fr.karamati: (À Lui) mon repentir, mon agrément, ma gratitude et ma louange : qu'Il est généreux comme Seigneur ! Par Lui mon cœur a grandi.

bayts.text: سَأَرْضِيهِ عَبْدًا رَّاضِيًا عَنْهُ شَاكِرًا ۞ بِكَوْنِى لَهُ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لِّمَنْ حَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Lo compiacerò, servo compiaciuto di Lui e grato, con il mio essere Suo servo e servitore di colui che Egli ha amato.
translations.en.karamati: I shall please Him, a servant pleased with Him and grateful, by being His servant and the servant of him whom He loved.
translations.fr.karamati: Je Le satisferai, serviteur satisfait de Lui et reconnaissant, par mon être Son serviteur et serviteur de celui qu'Il a aimé.

bayts.text: أُنَاجِيهِ بِالْقُرْءَانِ شُكْرًا لَّهُ بِهِ ۞ عَلَى حِفْظِهِ دَاْبًا وَأَرْجُو بِهِ الْحُبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Lo invoco in intimità con il Corano, ringraziandoLo con esso della Sua custodia, incessantemente, e spero per mezzo di esso l'amore.
translations.en.karamati: I call on Him intimately with the Qurʾān, thanking Him by it for His safekeeping, unceasingly, and through it I hope for love.
translations.fr.karamati: Je L'invoque intimement par le Coran, Le remerciant par lui de Sa garde, sans cesse, et j'espère par lui l'amour.

bayts.text: كِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ لَّايُرَاعِيهِ عَابِدٌ ۞ وَيَتْلُوهُ إِلَّا وَاحْتَوَى الْفَتْحَ وَالْقُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Un Libro possente: nessun adoratore lo osserva e lo recita senza ottenere l'apertura e la vicinanza.
translations.en.karamati: A mighty Book: no worshipper observes it and recites it without attaining opening and nearness.
translations.fr.karamati: Un Livre puissant : nul adorateur ne l'observe et ne le récite sans obtenir l'ouverture et la proximité.

bayts.text: كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ مِّنْ كَرِيمٍ مُّكَرِّمٍ ۞ لِعَبْدٍ كَرِيمٍ نَّوَّرَ الشَّرْقَ وَالْغَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Un Libro nobile da parte di un Nobile che onora, per un servo nobile che ha illuminato l'Oriente e l'Occidente.
translations.en.karamati: A noble Book from a Noble One Who honours, for a noble servant who illumined East and West.
translations.fr.karamati: Un Livre noble de la part d'un Noble qui honore, pour un serviteur noble qui a illuminé l'Orient et l'Occident.

bayts.text: كِتَابٌ مَّجِيدٌ مِّنْ مَّجِيدٍ مُّمَجِّيدٍ ۞ لِعَبْدٍ مَّجِيدٍ قَدْ عَلَا الْعُجْمَ وَالْعُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Un Libro glorioso da parte di un Glorioso che glorifica, per un servo glorioso che ha sovrastato i non Arabi e gli Arabi.
translations.en.karamati: A glorious Book from a Glorious One Who glorifies, for a glorious servant who rose above non-Arabs and Arabs.
translations.fr.karamati: Un Livre glorieux de la part d'un Glorieux qui glorifie, pour un serviteur glorieux qui a surpassé les non-Arabes et les Arabes.

bayts.text: كِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ مِنْ عَزِيزٍ مُّعَزِّزٍ ۞ لِعَبْدٍ عَزِيزٍ دُونَهُ مَنْ حَوَى قُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Un Libro possente da parte di un Possente che rende possenti, per un servo possente al di sotto del quale sta chiunque abbia ottenuto vicinanza.
translations.en.karamati: A mighty Book from a Mighty One Who gives might, for a mighty servant beneath whom stands whoever has attained nearness.
translations.fr.karamati: Un Livre puissant de la part d'un Puissant qui rend puissant, pour un serviteur puissant au-dessous duquel se tient quiconque a obtenu la proximité.

bayts.text: فَطُوبَى لِعَبْدٍ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ ۞ بِتَرْتِيلِ قُرْءَانٍ عَظِيمٍ يَقِى كَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Beato dunque il servo che adora Allah, suo Signore, con la recitazione cadenzata di un Corano immenso che preserva dall'angoscia!
translations.en.karamati: Blessed then is the servant who worships Allah, his Lord, with the measured recitation of a mighty Qurʾān that guards against distress!
translations.fr.karamati: Bienheureux donc le serviteur qui adore Allah, son Seigneur, par la récitation psalmodiée d'un Coran immense qui préserve de l'angoisse !

bayts.text: كِتَابٌ بِهِ مَسَّكْتُ مُسْتَغْنِيًا بِهِ ۞ غَرِيبًا وَأَنْسَانِى الْمُصِيبَاتِ وَالْكَأْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Un Libro al quale mi sono aggrappato, bastandomi di esso, straniero (in esilio), ed esso mi ha fatto dimenticare le sventure e la tristezza.
translations.en.karamati: A Book I held fast to, content with it alone, a stranger (in exile), and it made me forget misfortunes and gloom.
translations.fr.karamati: Un Livre auquel je me suis agrippé, me suffisant de lui, étranger (en exil), et il m'a fait oublier les malheurs et la tristesse.

bayts.text: بِهِ زَالَ غَمِّى حِينَ أَمْسَكْتُهُ هُدَى ۞ سَأَهْدِى بِهِ نَفْسِى وَأَهْدِى بِهِ الصَّحْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di esso è svanita la mia angoscia quando l'ho afferrato come guida; per mezzo di esso guiderò la mia anima e guiderò i compagni.
translations.en.karamati: Through it my grief vanished when I seized it as guidance; through it I shall guide my soul and guide the companions.
translations.fr.karamati: Par lui s'est dissipée mon angoisse quand je l'ai saisi comme guide ; par lui je guiderai mon âme et je guiderai les compagnons.

bayts.text: فَمَنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ دَهْرًا بِهِ ذَاتَمَسُّكٍ ۞ فَقَدْ قَادَهُ إِبْلِيسُ مَنْ لَّمَ يَزَلْ خِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Chi non vi resta aggrappato per tutto il tempo, lo ha già condotto Iblīs, colui che non cessa di essere ingannatore.
translations.en.karamati: Whoever does not hold fast to it all his time, Iblīs has already led him, he who never ceases to deceive.
translations.fr.karamati: Qui ne s'y tient pas agrippé tout le temps, Iblīs l'a déjà conduit, lui qui ne cesse d'être trompeur.

bayts.text: بِرَبِّى أَعُوذُ الدَّهْرَ مِنْ مَّكْرِهِ وَمِنْ ۞ جَمِيعِ الْأَعْدِى نِعْمَ رَبُّ الْوَرَى رَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Nel mio Signore mi rifugio per sempre dalla sua astuzia e da tutti i nemici: quale eccellente Signore è il Signore delle creature!
translations.en.karamati: In my Lord I take refuge for ever from his cunning and from all enemies: what an excellent Lord is the Lord of creatures!
translations.fr.karamati: En mon Seigneur je me réfugie pour toujours contre sa ruse et contre tous les ennemis : quel excellent Seigneur est le Seigneur des créatures !

bayts.text: إِلَهِى اكْفِنِى إِبْلِيسَ وَاحْبِسْهُ سَرْمَدًا ۞ وَهَبْ لِى دَوَامَ الذِّكْرِ وَالشُّكْرِ وَالْحُبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, preservami da Iblīs e imprigionalo per sempre, e donami la perpetuità del ricordo, della gratitudine e dell'amore.
translations.en.karamati: My God, spare me Iblīs and imprison him for ever, and grant me unceasing remembrance, gratitude and love.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, préserve-moi d'Iblīs et emprisonne-le pour toujours, et accorde-moi la perpétuité du rappel, de la gratitude et de l'amour.

bayts.text: إِلَهِى احْبِسِ الْأَعْدَآءَ عَنِّى وَنَجِّنِى ۞ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْكُفْرَانِ وَلْتَكْفِنِى سَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, trattieni da me i nemici e salvami dalla miscredenza e dall'ingratitudine, e preservami dalla spoliazione.
translations.en.karamati: My God, hold the enemies back from me and save me from disbelief and ingratitude, and spare me despoiling.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, retiens loin de moi les ennemis et sauve-moi de la mécréance et de l'ingratitude, et préserve-moi de la spoliation.

bayts.text: إِلَهِى قِنِى مَيْلًا إِلَى غَيْرِ مُرْتَضًى ۞ وَجَنِّبْنِىَ الْئَافَاتِ وَلْتَكْفِنِى خَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, preservami dal piegarmi verso ciò che non è gradito, tienimi lontano dalle calamità e preservami dall'inganno.
translations.en.karamati: My God, guard me from inclining to what is not approved, keep calamities from me and spare me deceit.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, préserve-moi de pencher vers ce qui n'est pas agréé, éloigne de moi les calamités et préserve-moi de la tromperie.

bayts.text: أَيَارَبِّ إِنِّى تُبْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَامَضَى ۞ فَعَنِّى امْحُ عَيْبِى كُلَّهُ وَاكْفِنِى تَغْبَا

translations.it.karamati: O Signore, io mi sono pentito di tutto ciò che è passato: cancella dunque da me ogni mio difetto e preservami dalla corruzione.
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, I have repented of all that is past: so erase all my faults from me and spare me corruption.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Seigneur, je me suis repenti de tout ce qui est passé : efface donc de moi tout mon défaut et préserve-moi de la corruption.

bayts.text: أَيَارَبِّ لِى اغْفِرْ وَامْحُ عَنِّى تَجَرُّإِ ۞ وَلِى اشْكُرْ مَتَابِى وَاكْفِنِى رِدَّةً دَاْبَا

translations.it.karamati: O Signore, perdonami, cancella da me la mia audacia, gradisci il mio pentimento e preservami sempre dall'apostasia.
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, forgive me, erase my presumption from me, accept my repentance and ever spare me apostasy.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Seigneur, pardonne-moi, efface de moi mon audace, agrée mon repentir et préserve-moi toujours de l'apostasie.

bayts.text: لَهُ تَبْتُ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مُسْتَمْسِكًا بِهِ ۞ مَعَ الْمُصْطَفَى الْمُخْتَارِ مَنْ لَّمْ يَزَلْ حِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: A Lui mi sono pentito, aggrappandomi al Corano, con l'Eletto, il Prescelto, colui che non cessa di essere il diletto,
translations.en.karamati: To Him I have repented, holding fast to the Qurʾān, with the Chosen One, the Select, he who never ceases to be the beloved,
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Lui je me suis repenti, en m'attachant au Coran, avec l'Élu, le Préféré, celui qui ne cesse d'être le bien-aimé,

bayts.text: إِمَامِى الَّذِى صَيَّرْتَنِى خَادِمًا لَّهُ ۞ بِنَظْمٍ وَنَثْرٍ وَلْتُنَوِّرْ بِهِ الْقَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: il mio imām, di cui mi hai reso servitore con la poesia e la prosa: per mezzo di lui illumina il cuore.
translations.en.karamati: my imām, whose servant You made me through poetry and prose: through him illumine the heart.
translations.fr.karamati: mon imām, dont Tu m'as fait serviteur par la poésie et la prose : par lui illumine le cœur.

bayts.text: لَهُ خِدَمَتِى مَادُمْتُ حَيًّا فَكُنْ بِهِ ۞ مُحِيذِى مِنِ افْسَادٍ وَرُضْ لِى بِهِ صَعْبَا

translations.it.karamati: A lui il mio servizio finché vivrò: sii dunque, per mezzo di lui, mio Rifugio dalla corruzione, e doma per me, per mezzo di lui, ciò che è difficile.
translations.en.karamati: To him my service as long as I live: so be, through him, my Refuge from corruption, and tame for me, through him, what is hard.
translations.fr.karamati: À lui mon service tant que je vivrai : sois donc, par lui, mon Refuge contre la corruption, et dompte pour moi, par lui, ce qui est difficile.

bayts.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِئَالِهِ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَاقْبَلْ بِهِ مِنِّىَ الْكَسْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Decreta per lui una benedizione con il saluto di pace, insieme alla sua Famiglia e ai suoi Compagni, e per mezzo di lui accetta da me il guadagno.
translations.en.karamati: Decree for him a blessing with peace, with his Family and his Companions, and through him accept my earnings from me.
translations.fr.karamati: Décrète pour lui une bénédiction avec le salut de paix, avec sa Famille et ses Compagnons, et par lui accepte de moi le gain.

bayts.text: وَلِى هَبْ بِّهِ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَرَاغِبِى ۞ وَزَحْزِحْ دَوَامًا عَنْ جَنَابِى بِهِ نَكْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E donami, per mezzo di lui, nel mondo e nell'Altro, i miei desideri, e allontana sempre dal mio territorio, per mezzo di lui, la sventura.
translations.en.karamati: And grant me, through him, in this world and the Other, my desires, and ever drive misfortune from my precinct through him.
translations.fr.karamati: Et accorde-moi, par lui, en ce monde et dans l'Autre, mes désirs, et écarte toujours de mon territoire, par lui, le malheur.

bayts.text: وَلِى افْتَحْ بِهِ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا يَقُودُنِى ۞ إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَجَنِّبْنِىَ الْعُجْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E aprimi per mezzo di lui un'apertura evidente che mi conduca alla pietà e al timor di Dio, e tienimi lontano dall'orgoglio.
translations.en.karamati: And open for me through him a manifest opening that leads me to piety and God-fearing, and keep me from conceit.
translations.fr.karamati: Et ouvre-moi par lui une ouverture évidente qui me conduise à la piété et à la crainte de Dieu, et éloigne de moi la vanité.

bayts.text: إِلَيْكَ اشْتِكَاءِ رَبِّ جَهْلِى وَغُرْبَتِى ۞ فَقُدْنِى لِإِخْوَانِى بِهِ وَاكْفِنِى تَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: A Te è il mio lamento, Signore, della mia ignoranza e del mio esilio: conducimi dunque ai miei fratelli per mezzo di lui, e preservami dalla perdizione.
translations.en.karamati: To You is my complaint, Lord, of my ignorance and my exile: so lead me to my brothers through him, and spare me perdition.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi est ma plainte, Seigneur, de mon ignorance et de mon exil : conduis-moi donc vers mes frères par lui, et préserve-moi de la perdition.

bayts.text: وَعَلِّمْنِىَ الْعِلْمَ اللَّدُ نِّىَّ بَارِعًا ۞ مُطِيعًا تَقِيًا مُّفْلِحًا يُرْشِدُ الشَّعْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E insegnami la scienza che viene da Te (Corano 18:65), (rendendomi) eccellente, obbediente, timorato, prospero, guida per il popolo.
translations.en.karamati: And teach me the knowledge from Your presence (Qurʾān 18:65), (making me) excellent, obedient, God-fearing, prosperous, a guide to the people.
translations.fr.karamati: Et enseigne-moi la science qui vient de Toi (Coran 18:65), (me rendant) excellent, obéissant, pieux, prospère, guide pour le peuple.

bayts.text: وَبَشِّرْ ذَاوِى الْإِسْلَامِ طُرًّا بِأَوْبَتِى ۞ إِلَى إِخْوَتِى وَلْتَقْضِ لِى قَبْلَهَا الْأَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E rallegra tutti i musulmani con il mio ritorno presso i miei fratelli, e prima di esso compi per me il mio bisogno.
translations.en.karamati: And gladden all the Muslims with my return to my brothers, and before it fulfil my need for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Et réjouis tous les musulmans par mon retour auprès de mes frères, et avant lui accomplis pour moi mon besoin.

bayts.text: وَسُقْ لِى بِجَاهِ الْمُصْطَفَى الدَّهْرَ حَاجَتِى ۞ بِلَا كُلْفَةٍ مِّنِّى وَهَبْ لِى بِهِ الْجَذْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E conducimi per sempre, per il rango dell'Eletto, ciò di cui ho bisogno, senza fatica da parte mia, e donami per mezzo di lui l'attrazione (divina).
translations.en.karamati: And lead to me for ever, by the rank of the Chosen One, my need, without toil on my part, and grant me through him the (divine) attraction.
translations.fr.karamati: Et amène-moi pour toujours, par le rang de l'Élu, ce dont j'ai besoin, sans peine de ma part, et accorde-moi par lui l'attraction (divine).

bayts.text: وَعَجِّلْ خُرُوجِى مِنْ عُيُوبِى جَمِيعِهَا ۞ وَقُدْنِى إِلَى طُوبَى وَعَنْهَا اصْرِفِ الْجَدْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E affretta la mia uscita da tutti i miei difetti, conducimi a Ṭūbā (Touba) e allontana da essa la siccità.
translations.en.karamati: And hasten my departure from all my faults, lead me to Ṭūbā (Touba) and turn drought away from it.
translations.fr.karamati: Et hâte ma sortie de tous mes défauts, conduis-moi à Ṭūbā (Touba) et écarte d'elle la sécheresse.

bayts.text: وَعَنْهَا اصْرِفِ لشَّيْتَانَ وَالسُّوءَ سَرْمَدًا ۞ وَوَجِّهْ لِىَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَلْتُومِنِ التُّرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E allontana da essa Satana e il male per sempre, rivolgi a me i beni e rendi sicura la (sua) terra.
translations.en.karamati: And turn Satan and evil away from it for ever, direct good things to me and make (its) soil secure.
translations.fr.karamati: Et écarte d'elle Satan et le mal pour toujours, tourne vers moi les biens et rends sûre (sa) terre.

bayts.text: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا وَفِى كُلِّ مَاحَوَتْ ۞ وَفِيهَآ أَقِمْنِى وَاهْدِنِى التِّرْبَ فَالتِّرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E benedici per noi in essa e in tutto ciò che contiene; fammi dimorare in essa e guidami (insieme ai) compagni, uno dopo l'altro.
translations.en.karamati: And bless us in it and in all it contains; make me dwell in it and guide me (with my) companions, one after another.
translations.fr.karamati: Et bénis pour nous en elle et en tout ce qu'elle contient ; fais-moi y demeurer et guide-moi (avec les) compagnons, l'un après l'autre.

bayts.text: إِلَهِى إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ الَّتِى بِهَا ۞ أُنَاجِيكَ قُدْنِى عَاجِلًا وَاكْفِنِى حَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, a Dār as-Salām (Darou Salam), nella quale Ti invoco in intimità, conducimi presto, e preservami dalla guerra.
translations.en.karamati: My God, to Dār as-Salām (Darou Salam), in which I call on You intimately, lead me soon, and spare me war.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, vers Dār as-Salām (Darou Salam), où je T'invoque intimement, conduis-moi bientôt, et préserve-moi de la guerre.

bayts.text: وَجَنِّبْ ذَوِى الْعُدْوَانِ وَالشَّرِّ جَانِبِى ۞ دَوَامًا وَهَبْ لِى النَّصْرَ وَالْوُدَّ وَالْقُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E tieni lontani dalla mia parte gli aggressori e i malvagi, per sempre, e donami la vittoria, l'affetto e la vicinanza.
translations.en.karamati: And keep the aggressors and the wicked away from my side, for ever, and grant me victory, affection and nearness.
translations.fr.karamati: Et tiens éloignés de mon côté les agresseurs et les méchants, pour toujours, et accorde-moi la victoire, l'affection et la proximité.

bayts.text: وَزِدْنِى عُلُومًا ذَا هُدًى وَاسْتِقَامَةً ۞ وَبِى رَبِّ يَارَبِّى ذَوِى الْبُعْدِ وَالْقُرْبَى

translations.it.karamati: E accrescimi in scienze, (rendendomi) dotato di guida e di rettitudine, e per mezzo mio educa, o mio Signore, i lontani e i vicini.
translations.en.karamati: And increase me in sciences, (making me) endowed with guidance and uprightness, and through me nurture, O my Lord, the far and the near.
translations.fr.karamati: Et accrois-moi en sciences, (me rendant) doté de guidance et de rectitude, et par moi éduque, ô mon Seigneur, les lointains et les proches.

bayts.text: وَهَبْ لِى بِكَ اسْتِغْنًا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ خَادِيمًا ۞ لِمَنْ جُودُهُ قَدْ أَخْجَلَ الْوَبْلَ مُنْصَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: E donami, per mezzo Tuo, l'indipendenza dalle creature, (rendendomi) servitore di colui la cui generosità ha fatto arrossire l'acquazzone che si riversa:
translations.en.karamati: And grant me, through You, independence from creatures, (making me) servant of him whose generosity has shamed the pouring downpour:
translations.fr.karamati: Et accorde-moi, par Toi, l'indépendance à l'égard des créatures, (me rendant) serviteur de celui dont la générosité a fait rougir l'averse qui se déverse :

bayts.text: حَبِيبِى أَنِيسِى فِى اغْتِرَابِى وَتُرْبَتِى ۞ شَفِيعِى غَدًا يَوْمًا يُلَاقِى الْعِدَى تَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: mio diletto, mio compagno nel mio esilio e nella mia tomba, mio intercessore domani, nel giorno in cui i nemici incontreranno la perdizione.
translations.en.karamati: my beloved, my companion in my exile and in my grave, my intercessor tomorrow, on the day the enemies meet perdition.
translations.fr.karamati: mon bien-aimé, mon compagnon dans mon exil et dans ma tombe, mon intercesseur demain, au jour où les ennemis rencontreront la perdition.

bayts.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ سَلَامُهُ ۞ بِئَالٍ وَأَصْحَابٍ حَوَوْاْ عِنْدَهُ خِصْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Su di lui la benedizione di Allah, poi la Sua pace, con la Famiglia e i Compagni che hanno ottenuto presso di lui l'abbondanza.
translations.en.karamati: Upon him be the blessing of Allah, then His peace, with the Family and the Companions who gained abundance with him.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur lui la bénédiction d'Allah, puis Sa paix, avec la Famille et les Compagnons qui ont obtenu auprès de lui l'abondance.

bayts.text: إِلَهِى امْحُ عَيْبِى كُلَّهُ وَاكْفِنِى الْأَذَى ۞ بِهِ وَاكْفِنِى الْأَعْدَآءَ وَالنَّارَ وَالسَّبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, cancella ogni mio difetto e preservami dal danno per mezzo di lui, e preservami dai nemici, dal Fuoco e dall'insulto.
translations.en.karamati: My God, erase all my faults and spare me harm through him, and spare me enemies, the Fire and insult.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, efface tout mon défaut et préserve-moi du mal par lui, et préserve-moi des ennemis, du Feu et de l'insulte.

bayts.text: وَقُدْنِى لِأَهْلِى سَالِمًا غَانِمًا بِهِ ۞ وَدَاْبًا قِنِى إِبْلِيسَ وَالْعَارَ وَالذَّنْبَا

translations.it.karamati: E conducimi alla mia famiglia, sano e ricco di bottino, per mezzo di lui, e preservami sempre da Iblīs, dalla vergogna e dal peccato.
translations.en.karamati: And lead me to my family, safe and laden with gain, through him, and ever guard me from Iblīs, shame and sin.
translations.fr.karamati: Et conduis-moi vers ma famille, sain et chargé de butin, par lui, et préserve-moi toujours d'Iblīs, de la honte et du péché.

bayts.text: لَكَ الشُّكْرُ وَالرِّضْوَانُ مِنِّى وَشَاهِدِ ۞ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ فِى الْجَزِيرَةِ مَايُنْبَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te la gratitudine e il compiacimento da parte mia, e mio testimone è un Osservatore pronto (Corano 50:18), nell'isola, a Mayumba.
translations.en.karamati: To You be gratitude and contentment from me, and my witness is a ready Watcher (Qurʾān 50:18), on the island, at Mayumba.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi la gratitude et l'agrément de ma part, et mon témoin est un Observateur prêt (Coran 50:18), dans l'île, à Mayumba.
